visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular male creator wearing a black tank top and black athletic shorts pushes a heavy sled loaded with black weight plates across a green artificial turf track. The gym background is well-lit with studio lighting, featuring equipment like racks and a prominent '3MUSCLERS' logo on a grey ribbed wall. (2) The man sits on the sled, looking directly at the camera and gesturing with his right hand as he speaks; several text bullet points appear sequentially to his right. (3) A series of dynamic shots follow, showing the man pushing the sled from a low side angle, a rear tracking shot, and a front close-up, illustrating varying intensities and speeds of movement. (4) An anatomical graphic overlay appears on the left side of the screen, highlighting the glutes and quadriceps in red to show muscle activation. (5) The creator returns to a seated position on the sled, maintaining eye contact with the camera and finishing his presentation with relaxed body posture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 減肥神器 推雪橇. (2) [Slogan]: 高強度阻力 全身性 心肺消耗 高心率燃脂 後燃效應. (3) [Subtitle]: 推雪橇就是力量訓練版的有氧. [Slogan]: 能同時練到肌肉跟心肺 對減肥超省時有效. (4) [Slogan]: 輕重量快推 約體重 x 0.8 增強心肺、爆發力 提升運動表現. (5) [Slogan]: 中重量長距離推 約體重 x 1.5 訓練肌耐力 減肥效果更提升. (6) [Slogan]: 大重量慢推 約體重 x 2 增強肌肉神經連結 強化肌肥大. (7) [Variety]: 鍛鍊肌群. [Slogan]: 除了強化核心穩定 還能讓你練出迷人的臀腿線條.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular Asian man with a short haircut, wearing a black 'TEAMJOINED' tank top and black shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern commercial gym featuring artificial green turf, grey ribbed walls with branding, and various weightlifting racks and cardio machines in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and professional clarity, accompanied by a heavy electronic phonk beat characterized by aggressive bass transients. (2) Each visual cut is reinforced with a sharp 'whoosh' sound effect, while the speaker's vocal pitch remains consistently engaged. (3) A distinct mechanical friction sound (sled on turf) is layered in whenever the physical action is shown, alongside the subtle clank of metal weights. (4) Soft digital UI 'pings' or 'pops' signal the appearance of on-screen text graphics, while the BGM maintains a steady, driving tempo. (5) The voice-over maintains a strong presence until the final two seconds, where the background music and ambient sounds fade out abruptly with a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Explanation -> Categorized Examples -> Summary -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate gym-goers on the benefits of using a weighted sled for both weight loss and strength, providing specific weight ratios for different training goals.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Consistent presence of '3MUSCLERS' branding and the creator wearing 'TEAMJOINED' apparel.
